dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: What'll it be today?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Any recommendations?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: The apple cider from the Dawn Winery is a special at Angel's Share.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: You can try my special cocktail if you want. It's on the house if it's your first time here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of liquor is the best?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: If you like strong wine, then I'd recommend that you try Death After Noon. It's Captain Kaeya's favorite.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: But the strongest wine I know has to be the one called Fire-Water.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: It hails from Snezhnaya, and was brought into Mondstadt by Snezhnayan merchants, but Master Diluc stopped importing it, saying that it didn't fit the tastes of the people here.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: The only remaining bottle is from the original batch. It's for display purposes only, though, so you'll have to go to Snezhnaya if you want to try some.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: You want to know about me?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I've been working as a bartender here for more than a decade. I'm employed by the Dawn Winery, like everyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I'm not that interested in alcohol, but it's my job so...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I mean, I'm not like Diona at Cat's Tail. I heard she hates alcohol.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Occasionally, Master Diluc, the owner of the winery, will cover my shift.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Days off are precious after all, so I'm very thankful to him for that.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Oh, not for me. Thanks anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Really? Shouldn't drink too much anyway, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy something to drink.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Here's the menu. Let me know once you're ready to order.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: It's been quite the headache for sure. Stormterror's affected our tavern's supply routes, so the variety of wines here has also dropped...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: As for Stormterror itself, I'm not too worried. I think those people who numb themselves with alcohol are just scared out of their wits.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: But we do reach the point of no return, then we just need to wait for night to fall.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: The "Knight Who Emerges At Night" will not just stand idly by.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Well, what's passed has passed, I say.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Life isn't all sweet fruit juice. It also needs some bitter alcohol. These incidents will also become part of our experience.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Rather than ask how this could happen, we should look forward to the future. Accepting the bitter with the sweet is how adults do things.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Once you're ready for the bitter, I'll pour you a special brew.
